title: Maximum EMF condition
description: Essential: The answer for part (1) must correctly state the condition for rod b to remain stationary and provide the expression for E_0.

title: Joule heat expression
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) must provide the correct expression for the Joule heat generated by rod a.

title: Rod b speed
description: Essential: The answer for part (3) must provide the correct expression for the speed of rod b at time t_0.

title: Force balance on rod b
description: Important: The solution for part (1) must apply the condition that the magnetic force on rod b equals the maximum tension F_0.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: The solution for part (2) must correctly apply energy conservation or work-energy principles to find the Joule heat.

title: Momentum conservation application
description: Important: The solution for part (3) must correctly apply the impulse-momentum theorem or conservation of momentum to the system of rods.

title: Circuit analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly analyze the circuit involving the capacitor, rods, and motional EMF.

title: Capacitor charging/discharging
description: Optional: The solution may correctly calculate the initial capacitor voltage and its discharge during the process.

title: Sign error in force direction
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution uses an incorrect sign for the magnetic force direction on the rods.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the final answers are presented with inconsistent or missing units in derived expressions.
